mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals imminent Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% with accelerating rate increases) increase discount rates and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS 3m change > 0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS rising above 0.5% month-over-month) signals robust corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS 1m change > 0.5%.
